name: United Integrated Services
summary: United Integrated Services Co., Ltd. delivers a wide array of engineering and construction services across Taiwan. The company's expertise includes contracting for water infrastructure, instrumentation control, and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. They also specialize in the installation of cleanroom facilities and related operations, alongside the design and implementation of engineering toll collection systems and control apparatus for computer rooms. Their offerings extend to engineering services for traffic surveillance and control systems, as well as providing technical advisory services for project planning and design. Furthermore, the company develops and deploys factory computer control monitoring systems and engineering environment monitoring systems. They undertake electrical and mechanical engineering contracts, particularly for power transmission and distribution. United Integrated Services also handles the design, installation, maintenance, and trade of advanced computerized automatic engineering monitoring systems, and imports specialized telecom radio frequency equipment. Additionally, they are involved in contracting for computer and communication system integration projects, and in the manufacturing and commercialization of associated software and hardware.
